title: Thenali
desc: Thenali suffers from panophobia and seeks doctor Kailash's help but the latter denies his request. Later, when Kailash goes on a vacation with his family, Thenali joins them and charms his sister.

title: Haqdaar
desc: A story of justice and identity where a common man's struggle for his rightful place in society highlights corruption, courage, and the fight to be heard.

title: Pithamagan
desc: An imposter befriends a social outcast convicted in a drug-peddling case in prison. However, when they are released from jail, they get entangled in a local drug lord's vicious scheme.
